title: Compliance Release of Personal Sender Account Statements After Requests for Information
content:
For a statement requested on a Personal Sender Account, compliance release reads the requests for information issued on the account in the 12 months before the request date, an entry dated on the same calendar day 12 months earlier or before it no longer counting.

## Input — judgement — output

| Requests for information issued on the account in the 12 months | Judgement | Business days added to the counted statement window |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | many requests | 2 |
| exactly 1 | one request | 1 |
| none | no request | 0 |

When there are 2 or more, 2 business days are added to the counted statement window; when there is exactly 1, 1 business day is added; when there is none, nothing is added for compliance release.

## Points of judgement

- Every request for information issued on the account counts, whatever its topic (source of funds, identity, transfer activity or KYC refresh) and whether or not it has since been answered.
- Requests for information in the case files of individual transfers are not requests issued on the account and are not counted here.
- Hypothetical dates: for a statement requested on 1 December, a request for information issued on 2 December of the year before counts; one issued on 1 December of the year before no longer counts.
